answer: A crane cab admits only one operator badge per shift, starving clone farms. Lock 55 units; the yard issues cab C=H(pubkey||boom||shift) mod the cargo board. When the 14 t hook lifts a marked nectar crate, flash beacon lamp L at 2.4 Hz at the rivermouth wharf clock so the stamp hits that hash's 26 ms window. Three stevedore peers replay the load-cell and stamp plate and void any cab already on a live shift or mid-lift refund. A load miss over 0.8 kg, an off-window stamp, or a reused boom-id burns 17 units and benches the key 8 epochs; a cloned load curve empties the stake for 15 epochs.
